# Leo Surface Coatings Pvt Ltd

> Leo Surface Coatings is an industrial paint shop systems company based in Akurdi, Pune, India. It delivers turnkey paint shop EPC projects and industrial coating systems, including pre-treatment, liquid coating booths, powder coating lines, drying and baking equipment, supporting systems, and paint shop audit and upgrade services. It has been registered since 2002 and works with Eisenmann GmbH in India on E-Cube and E-shuttle paint booth systems.

## Products

- [Spray and Dip Pre-Treatment Systems](https://leosurfacecoatings.com/spray-dip-pre-treatment.html): Surface preparation before painting or powder coating, covering degreasing, alkaline cleaning, rinsing, conversion coating and passivation
- [Industrial Liquid Coating Booths](https://leosurfacecoatings.com/liquid-coating-booths.html): Wet paint and spray booths, including down-draft, cross-draft and side-draft types
- [Industrial Powder Coating Lines](https://leosurfacecoatings.com/powder-coating.html): Pre-treatment, electrostatic application and curing
- [Paint Drying Chambers](https://leosurfacecoatings.com/paint-drying-chamber.html): Controlled temperature, humidity, ventilation and filtration for drying and curing
- [Dry-off and Baking Ovens](https://leosurfacecoatings.com/dry-off-baking-oven.html): Convection, infrared, combination and vacuum oven types
- [Vehicle Shower Tester Equipment](https://leosurfacecoatings.com/shower-tester.html): Water leak testing for vehicles and components; manual, PLC-based, conveyorized and static systems
- [Air Supply Units with Temperature and RH Control](https://leosurfacecoatings.com/air-supply-units-with-temperature-and-rh-control.html): Temperature and humidity control for industrial processes

## Common questions

**What does Leo Surface Coatings do?**
Leo Surface Coatings delivers turnkey paint shop EPC projects and industrial coating systems from Pune, India, including pre-treatment, liquid coating booths, powder coating lines, drying and baking equipment, supporting systems, and paint shop audit and upgrade services.

**What is spray and dip pre-treatment?**
It is the surface preparation stage before painting or powder coating. Spray pre-treatment applies chemicals through nozzles and suits high-volume production. Dip pre-treatment immerses parts in chemical tanks and suits complex shapes and large components. Typical stages are degreasing, alkaline cleaning, rinsing, conversion coating and passivation.

**What types of liquid coating booths are there?**
Down-draft, cross-draft and side-draft booths. They differ in how air moves through the booth to contain overspray.

**What is a paint de-sludge system?**
A system that separates paint solids from water in a booth's sludge, dewaters the solids and allows the water to be reused, which reduces the volume of waste to dispose of.

**What does a booth and oven exhaust incinerator do?**
It treats volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and other hazardous emissions from painting and drying processes before they are released.

**What does a vehicle shower tester do?**
It simulates rain to help find water leaks in vehicles and components before they reach the market. Types include manual, PLC-based, conveyorized and static systems.

**What is the Eisenmann partnership?**
Leo Surface Coatings and Eisenmann GmbH formalised a strategic partnership in August 2023 to bring Eisenmann's E-Cube and E-shuttle paint booth systems to the Indian market.
